_about: The people the crowd is made of (tools/prep_people.py makes assets/stadium/crowd_people.glb and its three pictures from this). Every person is one whole Tripo character of about 1,500 triangles. `template` is the prompt for the concept picture, with `{who}` from the person; image[1] is `style` [0] and image[2] is `style` [1]. The top is always plain light grey and the trousers plain mid grey: those two greys are what the game repaints per fan (see `keys`). `source` is the raw model, from the project root; a person without one is skipped, so the list can hold people who are still to be made. `yaw` turns the model to face -Y in Blender (-90 for a model as Tripo gives it: they come facing +X). `height` (metres) overrides the gender's. `joints` overrides a joint prep_people.py found (names as printed after JOINTS; [x, y, z] with the height = 1, front = -Y, the person's left = +X). `keys` overrides a colour it sampled (`top`, `pants`: [r, g, b] 0..1 as in the texture; null: that part is not repainted). `options` tunes how the texture is read: `chroma` (0.07: how far from a sampled colour a pixel may be and still count as it) and `luma` ([0.5, 1.7]: how much darker and brighter), `sleeves` ("wrist", "elbow" or "shoulder": how far out along the arm the top goes; beyond it nothing is the top), `legs` ("ankle" or "knee": how far down the trousers go), `collar` (0.03: how far above the neck line the top goes in the middle; more for a top that comes up to the chin on somebody with no neck to speak of). `budgets` are the triangles of the middle and the plainest level; the nearest level is the model as it came.
template: A new character: a sports fan in the stands, {who}. Full body, front view, standing upright in a T-pose with arms straight out to the sides, palms down, and legs slightly apart. Stylized chunky 3D cartoon character with simple rounded shapes, a slightly big head, slightly oversized hands and shoes, in exactly the smooth matte clay 3D art style, face style and lighting of the characters in image[1], with the toy-like proportions of image[2]. The top is plain light grey and the trousers are plain mid grey, both one flat colour with no logos, no prints, no text, no stripes and no pockets in another colour. Bare hands, mouth closed or a closed-mouth smile. Matte, no gloss. Single isolated figure on a plain flat grey background, no floor shadow, no props.
